description: This file defines API endpoints for computing statistical summaries and dataset metadata through a FastAPI router. It includes route handlers for calculating statistics on datasets and retrieving dataset summaries, utilizing data services and schema models.

classes.name: StatsRequest
classes.description: Schema model for incoming statistics computation requests, including dataset filename and selected columns.

classes.name: StatsResponse
classes.description: Schema model for the response containing filename and list of column statistics.

classes.name: ColumnStats
classes.description: Schema representing statistics for a specific dataset column, such as count, mean, std, min, max, median.

methods.name: StatsResponse compute_stats( req: StatsRequest, data_service: DataService = get_data_service, )
methods.description: Handles POST requests to compute statistical summaries for specified dataset columns, returning a structured StatsResponse.

methods.name: Dict[str,Optional[object]] dataset_summary( filename: str = Query(..., description="Dataset filename"), data_service: DataService = get_data_service, )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to provide a quick summary including row count and columns for a dataset.

ctags.name: dataset_summary
ctags.signature: ( filename: str = Query(..., description="Dataset filename"), data_service: DataService = get_data_service, )
